title: Replace opaque computational documentation filenames
status_detail: Planned fifth child; blocked on architecture and development normalization, separate explicit activation required, and no automatic successor activation.
objective: Replace opaque numbered computational-document paths with descriptive topic-based paths while preserving scientific meaning, status, and Git history.
authorized_scope: Use the accepted inventory to rename and group computational pages in bounded topic families, preserving exact scientific content unless deterministic link or status corrections are required.
Create a computational index organized by physical system, workflow stage, and evidence status rather than numeric filename codes.
Update all maintained links and retain explicit mappings from former paths when needed for historical traceability.
completion_criteria: Current computational pages have descriptive lowercase kebab-case paths, the computational index explains their scientific and evidentiary status, and no current navigation depends on opaque numeric codes.
Every renamed page preserves its applicable specification authority, scientific assumptions, provenance references, and Git history.
All maintained links resolve and Sphinx passes with warnings as errors.
exclusions: Do not change scientific settings, values, classifications, acceptance claims, calculation inputs or outputs, specifications, or execute scientific software.
Do not rename the entire family in one unreviewable change or activate a successor automatically.
